headline: UKRAINE 🪖🍆 CRAWLS INSIDE 1M DICKameter PIPELINE 🕳️💦
text:
‼️WAKE UP all you TRENCH 🪖 TROLLS 🕳️😩‼️ UKRAINE'S 1️⃣3️⃣th Khartiia Brigade 🪖🍑 has been bareBACKing 💦💦 inside an old Soviet gas pipeLINE 🧱🍆 for 7️⃣ MONTHS 🕒😳 near Kupyansk where 📍 the DICKameter is barely over 1️⃣ METRE 📏🍆 so soldiers can 🧎 only CRAWL 🐛🙇 through the tight KharkiHOLE 🕳️🍑 while Russian drones 🚁 buzz overhead making 🌄 surface advances IMPOSSIBLE 🚫😩‼️ BBC correspondent Jonathan Beale 📹 slid in first 📰👀 to film the underGROUND 🕳️ ORGY 🪖💦 where every inch 📏 of this pitch 🌑 black pipe 🖤🍆 gets stuffed with Ukrainian 🇺🇦 fighters RAWLING deeper 🕳️😳 to keep the front 🛡️ line from getting 💥 BUSTED open 😩‼️ The whole subterranean 🕳️ battle is now 🔄 a nonstop bareBACKing crawl 🐛💦 that keeps both 🪖 sides safe from sky 👀 eyes but leaves 👥 them packed tight 🥪 in the pipeLINE for months on end 🕒🍆

FORWARD ➡️ to 1️⃣0️⃣ drone dodging diggers 🪖🕳️
❌0️⃣ back = your HOLE stays EMPTY and EXPOSED 🕳️😭
✅5️⃣ back = you get 🐛 to CRAWL the pipeLINE 🧱 tonight 🌙🍆
✅🔟 back = UKRAINE 🇺🇦 bareBACKS Russia DEEP 🌍 underground 💦🪖
